openTomorrow: Yeah, definitely. I'm trying to build a streak and the visual of that fire emoji and the counter is actually pretty satisfying. Plus the share card would look clean on my Story.
secured: I think it means your progress is locked in or confirmed? Like once you complete a task, it's secured so it counts toward your streak and can't be undone.
freeze: I'm guessing it's like a safety feature where you can pause your streak for a day without losing it? For when life happens and you can't do the challenge but don't want to break your streak.
selfReported: That's when you manually log that you did the task instead of it being tracked automatically. You're basically telling the app 'yes, I did this today' and they trust your word.
best: Honestly? The moment I realized I could take a screenshot of my streak and throw it on my Story. The design is clean enough that it doesn't look desperate, you know? It just looks like I'm doing something for myself.
worst: Starting at 0 days. It's like... why am I even here if I haven't done anything yet? Made me feel like I was already behind before I even started. The empty circle for Thursday felt judgmental.
tellFriend: For sure. I'd be like 'Yo, there's this app called GRIIT where you can start these challenges and build streaks. And the share cards actually look good if you want to post about it. It's simple but kind of addictive.' I'd probably send them a screenshot of my eventual streak once I actually get one going.
